author: findings_scout
body:
# Findings scout: compatible reporting surface

Read-only inspection of the existing investigation workflow, tests, and documentation. No source or frozen tests changed.

## Current contracts

- Plans are source-bound JSON. `investigation.py` supports v1/v2; correspondence v3 is an opt-in closed schema in `investigation_correspondence.py` (`PLAN_KEYS`), with exact top-level keys `version`, `startedAt`, `budgetSeconds`, `scope`, `units`, `claims`, `correspondenceBundles`, `responses`, `reconciliations`, and optional `workBlockers`. It binds source spans by `{path, sha256, startLine, endLine}` and verifies quotes against current bytes through `SourceReader`.
- v1 status has work queues and source/authorship nonclaims but no `findings`. v2 emits `findings` only for local derivation workflow outcomes (`investigation_derivation.py`). v3 status projects bundle review and formal status; it drops the attributed response-level `classification` and `method` details into summaries (`complete-attributed` / `unresolved-attributed`) and has no finding rows. Contradictory reviews are reduced to incomplete summary rather than retained as separate findings.
- v3 preserves first responses immutably by digest in `responses`; corrections live in `reconciliations` with `firstResponseId`. `effective_responses` substitutes effective view but does not erase the original. Current plan identity is `digest(plan)` for stop records and progress receipts. Progress receipt schema is `ladon-investigation-progress-v1`; validation freshly rebuilds the receipt from exact plan/source/time, so changing status output affects receipt replay.
- `finish` is a status gate; checkpoint/finalize create fresh immutable receipts. Current v3 finish requires source inventory, mathematical review, and recorded formal links. That prevents an observation-only plan from finishing with an incomplete formal status.

## Minimal compatibility recommendation

- Make candidate discrepancy capture a v3 capability with an optional top-level `observations` array (absence means `[]`, preserving old v3 plans); keep it separate from `correspondenceBundles` so capture does not depend on extraction or a native artifact. Each observation should have a stable content digest ID, original scope/source span binding and exact quote, authored candidate statement, pending comparison/disposition, and evidence text. Review/disposition should append immutable transitions or preserve first response plus explicit reconciliation as v3 does. Require a disposition before an observation leaves the actionable queue; do not derive mathematical falsity from a correspondence mismatch.
- Project `findings` additively into all public v1/v2/v3 status outputs: legacy claims map their existing statement/method judgment, source map, formal contract/support/dependencies and uncertainty; v3 bundle responses map one row per authored response, retaining `responseId`, `firstResponseId` / reconciliation lineage, reviewer attribution, statement relation, method relation, source fidelity and formal support. Include observation rows even without bundles. Keep dimensions distinct (`mathematicalFalsity` or “not established”, `correspondence`, `method`, `argumentCoverage`); avoid a single severity/verdict. Historical receipt validation needs an explicit compatibility path for old `progress-v1` bytes because fresh status gains fields; issue a new progress receipt schema for the additive projection and keep v1 replay semantics stable.
- Add aggregate as a read-only v3 projection over supplementary plans. Require identical original `scope`, `startedAt`, and `budgetSeconds`; validate each input against the same root/source; preserve every observation and bundle; deduplicate only byte-identical IDs/records, and surface incompatible same-ID rows or conflicting reviews as visible conflicts. Preserve each plan ID and first response identity in aggregate provenance. Aggregate should feed the same status/final report builder, not rewrite source plans. Survey-only coverage should remain distinct from bundle/argument review, and observation-only completion may finalize with incomplete formal correspondence when no observation remains pending.

## Consumers and focused coverage

- Production entrypoints: `src/ladon/investigation.py` (`assess` version dispatch/status), `src/ladon/investigation_correspondence.py` (`PLAN_KEYS`, transitions, immutable responses), `src/ladon/investigation_correspondence_status.py` (v3 final/status projection), `src/ladon/investigation_correspondence_cli.py` (transition publishing), `src/ladon/investigation_cli.py` (public parser and `finish`), `src/ladon/investigation_finalization.py` (receipt replay). Existing report interfaces are stdout JSON and immutable JSON output; there is no separate investigation report renderer.
- Docs to update: `docs/INVESTIGATION_LOOP.md` for capture/inspect/review, observation queue, survey-vs-argument coverage, and observation-only incomplete formal finish; `docs/NL_LEAN_CORRESPONDENCE.md` for v3 optional observations, retained response/finding fields and supplementary aggregate; `docs/CORRESPONDENCE_DISCOVERY.md` for final reporting distinctions. Existing docs state authored evidence/labels are not authenticated or proof.
- Focused existing tests: `tests/test_investigation.py`, `tests/test_investigation_cli.py`, `tests/test_investigation_binding.py`, `tests/test_investigation_finalization.py`, `tests/test_investigation_stop_receipts.py`, `tests/test_investigation_work_blockers.py`, `tests/test_correspondence_investigation_v3.py`, `tests/test_correspondence_historical_profiles.py`, plus `tests/test_investigation_derivation_cli.py` / `tests/test_derivation_workflow.py` for v2. Add frozen tests for source-stale observations, capture without extraction, first response and contradictory review retention, absent counterpart, aggregation identity/scope/clock, and old progress-v1 receipt replay.
- Relevant final commands: `uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_investigation.py tests/test_investigation_cli.py tests/test_investigation_binding.py tests/test_investigation_finalization.py tests/test_investigation_stop_receipts.py tests/test_investigation_work_blockers.py tests/test_correspondence_investigation_v3.py tests/test_correspondence_historical_profiles.py tests/test_investigation_derivation_cli.py tests/test_derivation_workflow.py`; `uv run --locked python scripts/python_quality.py --strict`; `uv run --locked python -m ruff check src tests scripts`; `openspec validate ladon-correspondence-field-hardening-umbrella --type change --strict` (confirm CLI availability in this checkout). Full project tests remain a root integration decision.

## Scope caveat

The top-level umbrella `WORKPLAN.md` says to preserve source-bound authored observations and review judgments without asserting mathematical falsity or native proof, keep historical records unchanged, add no dependencies/network, and retain exact source maps and first-response identities. This report makes no diagnosis of the retrospective target mathematics.

# Findings and receipt projection proposal

This overlay adds `src/ladon/investigation_findings.py` and carries candidate copies of the three existing modules with the integration edits. No production or frozen test files were changed.

`legacy_findings(plan, derivation_findings=None)` emits rows only for authored statement mismatches, method differences, or unresolved judgments. Each row binds its identity to the claim, exact source span and judgment; it records `mathematicalFalsity: not-established`. The optional derivation rows preserve the v2 counterexample and attributed-refutation results already returned by the derivation pass.

`native_findings(plan, entries, responses)` projects reviewed native subjects with mismatch, different, unresolved, or conflicting labels. It retains first responses, all corrections and effective responses. A correction stays attributed to its first response owner. `coverage_summary(plan)` counts authored inventory and claim reviews while keeping whole-paper certification false.

The candidate status integration publishes additive `findings` and `coverage` fields for v1/v2 and adds native findings and a `statementReview` label to v3 bundle rows. The finalization integration emits progress-v2 receipts. Its `historical_status_projection(status, plan)` removes only additive projection fields and, for v2, keeps the old derivation findings so progress-v1 receipts can be rebuilt and checked against the exact original recorded time.

The complete candidate files are under `src/ladon/`; `patches.diff` contains only edits to the three existing modules. Root-owned observation projection still needs to be composed with these functions during integration.

Checks run: board `verify-tests` reported all three frozen artifacts matched before and after. Isolated Ruff and Python compilation passed; Radon maximum complexity for the new module is 9 (all functions below 11). author: findings_audit
body:
Aggregate reporting loses explicit pending branch attribution for observations whose statement label is present but whose method/source-fidelity review is unresolved or conflicted. In `src/ladon/investigation_observations.py:163-171`, any dimension outside the resolved sets keeps the observation actionable. But `src/ladon/investigation_reporting.py:86-87` populates `pendingPlanIds` only when `statementRelation == "unresolved"`.

Reproducer: `.codex/state/findings/audit/pending-method-repro.py` creates two compatible branches for one observation. Branch 1 has statement `aligned`, method `unresolved`, and remains in `branches[0].next`; branch 2 has a resolved aligned/same/faithful response. `aggregate_report` returns `findings[0].pendingPlanIds == []`, while the method summary is `conflicted`. This violates the contract that pending sibling work remains explicitly retained in aggregate findings, and downstream readers using the dedicated pending field can miss required review. The same predicate misses conflicted statement reviews and ambiguous/unresolved fidelity.

Minimal fix: derive `pendingPlanIds` from each branch status `next` (matching observation subject), or use the full observation resolution predicate across statement, method, and source fidelity. Add frozen tests for unresolved method and ambiguous fidelity with a resolved sibling. Existing 27 frozen reporting/observation tests and 37 existing investigation/v3 consumer tests pass; this edge is currently uncovered.
